deals.comment: NAVER WEBTOON CORP agreed to acquire 13.7% stake in Ylab Corporation for KRW 5.3 billion on April 28, 2020. As per the terms, consideration will be payable in cash and NAVER WEBTOON will acquire 1.4 million shares. As of December 31, 2019, Ylab Corporation reported total assets of KRW 9.5 billion and net loss of KRW 1.2 billion. The transaction is expected to be completed on May 12, 2020.

NAVER WEBTOON CORP. acquired an additional 14.86% stake in V.DO Inc from Dae Sik Kim and others for approximately KRW 240 million on December 31, 2020. As per terms, NAVER WEBTOON CORP. acquired 1,200 shares at KRW 201,550 per share. Dae Sik Kim sold 547 shares in the transaction.
NAVER WEBTOON CORP. acquired 14.9% stake in from Kim, Dae-sik and others for CNY 240 million on December 31, 2021.

Naver Webtoon Ltd. agreed to acquire 52.19% stake in Locus Co., Ltd. for KRW 23.48 billion on December 21, 2021. The deal is subject to approval from Naver Webtoon Ltd. board. As of December 21, 2021 Naver Webtoon Ltd. board approved the deal.
NAVER WEBTOON CORP. agreed to acquire unknown stake in Watong Entertainment Limited for KRW 4 billion on February 21, 2022. The transaction is expected to close on March 31, 2022.
